package noder
import("encoding/binary";"os";"strings";"testing";"go-backend-ssa/internal/cmd/obj";"go-backend-ssa/internal/cmd/sys";"go-backend-ssa/internal/ir";"go-backend-ssa/internal/typecheck";"go-backend-ssa/internal/types";"go-backend-ssa/internal/types2";"go-backend-ssa/internal/syntax")
func TestSyncgoBodyFixture(t *testing.T){
 arch:=strings.SplitN(os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET"),"-",2)[0];size:=8;var order binary.ByteOrder=binary.LittleEndian;frames:=0;if strings.HasSuffix(os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET"),"-nosync"){frames=-1};switch arch{case "386":size=4;case "mips":size=4;order=binary.BigEndian;case "ppc64":order=binary.BigEndian}
 link:=&obj.Link{Pathname:"/src",Arch:&obj.LinkArch{Arch:&sys.Arch{Name:arch,PtrSize:size,RegSize:size,ByteOrder:order}}};u:=types.NewUniverseWithPositions(size,size,1<<50,&link.PosTable);u.LocalPkg=u.NewPkg("example/p","p");g:=ir.NewContext(u,link);tc:=typecheck.NewContext(g);tc.InitUniverse();g.Base.Flag.Lang="go1.27";g.Base.Flag.Complete=true;g.Debug.SyncFrames=frames;g.Debug.RangeFuncCheck=1
 c,err:=NewContext(types2.NewContext(),tc);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 source:=`package p
var Global *int
func Heap()*int{x:=1;return &x}
func InlineHeap()*int{return Heap()}
func Stack(p int)int{x:=p;p2:=&x;return *p2}
func Identity(p *int)*int{return p}
func Store(p *int){Global=p}
func ByValue(x int)func()int{return func()int{return x}}
func ByReference(x int)func()int{return func()int{x++;return x}}
func CycleA(p *int,n int)*int{if n==0{return p};return CycleB(p,n-1)}
func CycleB(p *int,n int)*int{return CycleA(p,n)}
func SliceLength()[]int{n:=4;return make([]int,n)}
func ReadOnly(s string)int{b:=[]byte(s);return len(b)}
func Writable(s string)byte{b:=[]byte(s);b[0]=1;return b[0]}
func Deferred(p *int){defer func(){*p++}()}
func Async(p *int){go func(){*p++}()}
func Aggregate(p *int)*struct{P *int}{return &struct{P *int}{p}}
func AppendLocal(n int)int{s:=make([]int,0,4);for i:=0;i<n;i++{s=append(s,i)};return len(s)}
func AppendAliased(n int)int{s:=make([]int,0,4);var alias []int;for i:=0;i<n;i++{s=append(s,i);alias=s};return len(alias)}
`
 file,err:=syntax.Parse(syntax.NewFileBase("input.go"),strings.NewReader(source),nil,nil,syntax.CheckBranches);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 info:=&types2.Info{StoreTypesInSyntax:true,Defs:map[*syntax.Name]types2.Object{},Uses:map[*syntax.Name]types2.Object{},Selections:map[*syntax.SelectorExpr]*types2.Selection{},Implicits:map[syntax.Node]types2.Object{},Scopes:map[syntax.Node]*types2.Scope{},Instances:map[*syntax.Name]types2.Instance{},FileVersions:map[*syntax.PosBase]string{}}
 conf:=types2.Config{Context:c.Checker,GoVersion:"go1.27",Sizes:c.Checker.SizesFor("gc",arch)};files:=[]*syntax.File{file};pkg,err:=conf.Check("example/p",files,info);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 closures,err:=c.RewriteRangeFuncs(pkg,info,files);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};data,err:=c.WritePackage(pkg,info,files,closures);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err:=os.WriteFile(BODY_INPUT_PATH,[]byte(data),0600);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
}
